content: YouTube’s ad-free Premium subscription is getting another perk: access to Peacock. In an announcement on Monday, NBCUniversal says the multi-year agreement will allow Premium subscribers to stream Peacock’s ad-supported shows, movies, and live sports directly through the YouTube app in 2027. YouTube will bundle Peacock in its standard subscription, which increased to $15.99 / month in April, YouTube spokesperson Jessica Gibby confirmed to The Verge. That makes it cheaper than subscribing to both services individually, as Peacock currently starts at $10.99 / month for its ad-supported plan. The news of the deal comes at a pivotal time for Peacock, which is separating from Comcast’s broadband business alongside NBCUniversal and Sky. Matt Strauss, the chairman of NBCUniversal’s media group, says the agreement will boost Peacock’s “next phase of growth by bringing the service to millions of YouTube Premium subscribers.” YouTube revealed that it had 125 million Premium and Music subscribers in 2025, while Comcast’s most recent earnings report revealed that Peacock has 48 million subscribers in the US. Peacock also turned a profit for the first time last quarter. As part of the deal, NBCUniversal will stream “a selection of live sporting events” on YouTube, and it’s also extending its distribution agreement with YouTube TV.

chineseContent: YouTube 的无广告高级订阅还获得了另一项福利：访问 Peacock。 NBCUniversal 在周一的一份声明中表示，这项多年期协议将允许 Premium 订阅者在 2027 年直接通过 YouTube 应用观看 Peacock 的广告支持节目、电影和体育直播。YouTube 发言人 Jessica Gibby 向 The Verge 证实，YouTube 将把 Peacock 捆绑在其标准订阅中，该订阅价格在 4 月份涨至每月 15.99 美元。这比单独订阅这两项服务更便宜，因为 Peacock 目前的广告支持计划起价为 10.99 美元/月。该交易的消息发布之际，Peacock 正与 NBCUniversal 和 Sky 一起从康卡斯特的宽带业务中分离出来。 NBCUniversal 媒体集团董事长马特·施特劳斯 (Matt Strauss) 表示，该协议将通过为数百万 YouTube Premium 订阅者提供服务，推动 Peacock 下一阶段的增长。 YouTube透露，到2025年，其付费和音乐订阅用户将达到1.25亿，而康卡斯特最新的财报显示，Peacock在美国拥有4800万订阅用户。 Peacock上季度也首次实现盈利。作为交易的一部分，NBCUniversal 将在 YouTube 上直播“精选的体育赛事直播”，并且还将延长与 YouTube TV 的发行协议。
